title: LIC pensioners hold protest in Vellore

ai.summary: LIC pensioners held a protest in Vellore demanding pension updates aligned with Central Civil Services Pension Rules, 1971, removal of dearness allowance for pre-1997 retirees, and other benefits.

facts.claim: LIC pensioners held a protest in Vellore
facts.quote: A joint protest by pensioners of LIC and the All India Insurance Pensioners’ Association was held at the divisional office of LIC in Vellore town on Wednesday.

facts.claim: They demanded updation of pension in line with Central Civil Services Pension Rules, 1971
facts.quote: they demanded updation of pension in line with Central Civil Services Pension Rules, 1971 and on par with RBI Central Government Pensioner rules.

facts.claim: They demanded complete neutralisation of dearness allowance for those who retired prior to 1997
facts.quote: Another demand was a complete neutralisation of dearness allowance for those who retired prior to 1997.

facts.claim: The GST on health insurance policy premium for pensioners should also be withdrawn with immediate effect
facts.quote: The GST on health insurance policy premium for pensioners should also be withdrawn with immediate effect.

facts.claim: Other demands include preventive health check-up for pensioners, cash medical benefits
facts.quote: Other demands include preventive health check-up for pensioners, cash medical benefits.

facts.claim: The apprentice period should also be counted for calculating the pension for retired development officers
facts.quote: The apprentice period should also be counted for calculating the pension for retired development officers.
